---
title: "Site prototype (#99)"
---

Three versions of the same story page. Each has the full outline and one drafted section, *the methods*,
with the same interactive figure. Flip between them with the bar at the bottom or the ← / → keys.

- [A: Essay](a-essay.qmd): a long read in the style of the Thinking Machines post, notes in the margin.
- [B: Answer first](b-answer-first.qmd): the claim and its numbers up front, details on demand.
- [C: Handbook](c-handbook.qmd): a numbered outline in a sidebar, a fact card per method.
